# Drawflow

Visual flow editor used in admin automations.

- Upstream: https://github.com/jerosoler/Drawflow
- Version: 0.0.60
- License: MIT

To refresh vendored files:

```bash
node -e "..."  # see scripts/vendor-drawflow.mjs in repo root scripts/
```

Or download from jsDelivr `drawflow@0.0.60/dist/drawflow.min.js` and `drawflow.min.css`.
